name: focus_history.reverse
description: Step back through the focus changes the calling principal made.

cursor.description: The cursor from an earlier result, to keep stepping back from where that call stopped. Leave it out to start from where focus is now.

not_session_id.description: Only go back to a block in another session than this one.

not_window_id.description: Only go back to a block in another window than this one.

session_id.description: Only go back to a block in this session. The client must be attached to it.

window_id.description: Only go back to a block in this window.

cursor.description: Pass this as cursor in the next call to keep stepping back.

reversed.description: Whether the call moved focus. False means no place the request allows was left to go back to, and the other fields are left out.

session_id.description: The session that holds the block focus moved to. It may not be the session the client is showing.

window_id.description: The window that holds the block focus moved to. It is that session's active window.
